title: IRDAI: 85% of insurers now use AI
takeaways: 85% of Indian insurers use AI in some form, says IRDAI chief.
65% of life insurers surveyed don't automate suspicious-claim detection.
80.0% of non-life insurers surveyed use AI/ML claims detection.
Health claims paid ratio rose to 87.50% in FY25.
Insurance penetration stuck at 3.7% of GDP in FY25.
source_note: Sources: Business Standard; Gen Re 2025; IRDAI via Devdiscourse
